sota_findings: VERIFIED — OSWorld-Verified computer-use SOTA: Claude Sonnet 4.6 = 72.5%, Opus 4.6 = 72.7% (within 0.2pt), GPT-5.2 = 38.2% (Sonnet 4.6 nearly doubles it). Human baseline ~72%. Released 2026-02-17. Anthropic CUA is the OSWorld leader. CAVEAT: the Sep2025 Sonnet-4.5=61.4% baseline and the exact GPT-5.2 number are sourced from aggregators (digitalapplied, coasty.ai, natural20) corroborating the Anthropic Sonnet-4.6 news post / system card, not all from one primary doc. Sources: anthropic.com/news/claude-sonnet-4-6, www-cdn.anthropic.com Sonnet-4.6 system card PDF, digitalapplied.com.

VERIFIED — Web Bench (Halluminate + Skyvern): ~5,750 tasks / 500+ sites (~2,454/452 open-sourced). Best fully-automated agent reaches only 46.6% on WRITE-heavy tasks (login, form-fill, file ops, 2FA) vs >75% on READ/extract tasks (~28pt gap is the load-bearing finding). Root blockers (auth/CAPTCHA/longer trajectories/long-context) confirmed. Source: halluminate.ai/blog/benchmark, blog.skyvern.com. CAVEAT: the specific '66.0% all-tasks Anthropic CUA leads' subfigure I could not re-confirm verbatim from the blog snapshot (the qualitative leadership claim is supported; the exact 66.0% is plausible but treat as medium-confidence).

VERIFIED — Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6 hit 94% on a real insurance computer-use benchmark (the Pace insurance benchmark): multi-step web forms, spreadsheets, legacy desktop apps, end-to-end, no custom APIs/scripts. Confirms narrow-vertical scope beats the generic 46.6% write floor. Highest of any Claude model tested. Sources: digitalapplied.com Sonnet-4.6 guide, anthropic.com/news/claude-sonnet-4-6.

VERIFIED (numbers) / PARTIALLY-SUPPORTED (causal claim) — Browser Use = 89.1% WebVoyager, Magnitude = 93.9% WebVoyager SOTA (#1 vs #2, Operator #3 at 87%). Confirmed on Steel.dev leaderboard + magnitudedev/webvoyager + browser-use.com. CAVEAT: the finding's framing that 'DOM-aware beats pure-pixel' is INVERTED by the primary source — Magnitude (the #1) is explicitly PURE-VISION and beats DOM-based browser-use; the DOM-vs-pixel reliability split for gov-portal WRITE tasks is a separate, real argument (Gemini CU ingests DOM) but is NOT what the WebVoyager numbers prove. The 'high read scores do NOT predict gov-portal write success' caveat IS correct (WebVoyager is read-heavy, only 15 sites originally). Sources: github.com/magnitudedev/webvoyager, browser-use.com, leaderboard.steel.dev.

VERIFIED — Stealth-plugin (JS user-space) patching is structurally limited vs 2026 anti-bot/WAFs: cannot hide CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) automation-protocol fingerprinting, cannot fix TLS/JA3-JA4 mismatch (needs C++ Chromium rebuild), cannot fix IP/ASN reputation or JA4L latency-timing (data-center vs residential). 2026 SOTA = direct-CDP drivers (nodriver/patchright) + persistent profiles + residential IP + fingerprint consistency, not JS injection. Multiple independent 2026 sources converge. NOTE: word 'STRUCTURALLY OBSOLETE' is the finding's framing; sources phrase it as 'last resort / brittle / cannot address protocol layer' — same substance. Sources: scrapfly.io, alterlab.io (2026), ianlpaterson.com anti-detect benchmark 2026, datadome.co.

VERIFIED (HITL pattern) / SPLIT-SOURCE (one sub-clause) — 2026 production pattern for regulated/gov portals: human-in-the-loop mandatory, agents must notify a human with context on failure, demos/learned trajectories give UI-drift resilience but complex portals still need tweaks, SOC2/no-retention demanded. Supported by halluminate.ai, skyvern.com, workbeaver.com. CAVEAT: the appended sub-clause 'Anthropic Managed Agents run in a customer-controlled sandbox wired to private MCP servers under enterprise security boundaries' was NOT found on the cited SDK page (anthropic.com/engineering/building-agents-with-the-claude-agent-sdk, now redirects to claude.com/blog/...). That sentence conflates a different source; drop it or re-cite. The rest of the finding stands.

VERIFIED (verbatim) — Self-correction is an explicit reliability lever Anthropic ships: the Agent SDK page states verbatim 'Agents that can check and improve their own output are fundamentally more reliable—they catch mistakes before they compound, self-correct when they drift, and get better as they iterate.' AND advanced-tool-use page confirms 'Tool Use Examples, which provides a universal standard for demonstrating how to effectively use a given tool.' The Nuzantara-FASE-1 claim that this loop is broken at every joint is consistent with repo state (federation_orchestrator.py has NO checkpointer — grep confirmed empty; MOS memory p2_19 corroborates missing PostgresSaver). Sources: claude.com/blog/building-agents-with-the-claude-agent-sdk, anthropic.com/engineering/advanced-tool-use, Nuzantara scripts/federation_orchestrator.py.

opportunity: CONFIDENCE: HIGH on the strategic direction; the four SOTA pillars the opportunity rests on are all independently verified (75%+ read-accuracy, 46.6% write-floor, 94% vertical-narrow Anthropic-insurance, HITL-mandatory, self-correction-as-reliability-lever, stealth-obsolescence). The 'Gov-Portal Copilot' (assisted, NOT autonomous) for the 5 core Indonesian portals (OSS/BKPM, evisa imigrasi, DJP/coretax, AHU, LKPM) is well-founded: DRAFT-FILL human-in-the-loop (Claude/Gemini-CU pre-compiles from CRM+Drive-OCR, operator clicks submit) exploits the verified 75%+ read accuracy and sidesteps the verified 46.6% write floor, and maps cleanly onto Symbiosis Law 5 (propose-not-decide); SCOPE-NARROW per portal replicates the verified 94% insurance result; ABANDON stealth.py for gov portals (first-party, no aggressive WAF — verified that JS-stealth is the wrong tool anyway) in favor of persistent authenticated profiles; CLOSE the self-correction loop (add checkpointer to federation_orchestrator — repo-confirmed missing) as prerequisite so the agent learns from failures. CAVEATS on the ROI math (LOWER confidence — not independently verified this turn): the 'centinaia di ore-uomo/mese' saving and '60% of standard practices' are PLAUSIBLE but UN-VERIFIED estimates — they depend on the 11.699-client and per-practice-minutes figures which I did not re-derive; treat as order-of-magnitude, not measured. The 'marginal cost ~zero' claim is sound (Claude MAX OAuth + Gemini AI Ultra already paid, no metered API — consistent with the hard no-paid-API rule). The compliance-safety argument (human gate eliminates wrong-submission risk) is the strongest part and is structurally correct. RECOMMENDED PILOT (as stated, well-scoped): 1 portal (evisa renewal — most repetitive) × 10 real practices in shadow-mode with operator, AFTER the checkpointer fix. Net: greenlight the direction; require a measured baseline (actual operator minutes/practice on evisa renewal) before committing to the ROI numbers.

sota_findings: [VERIFIED, source corrected] CHURN ML SOTA 2026: gradient-boosting resta lo stato dell'arte produzione su churn tabellare (NON gli LLM). Verificato verbatim: XGBoost AUC-ROC 0.932, LightGBM 0.930, GradientBoosting 0.926; soft-voting ensemble F1 0.84 (AUC 0.918). Pipeline confermata: SMOTE k_neighbors=5 post-split, StandardScaler, Optuna 5-fold stratified, isotonic calibration, threshold 0.528, cost-sensitive C_FN=5/C_FP=1. CORREZIONE FONTE: il paper NON e' su Scientific Reports/nature.com (il DOI s41598-026-37407-z citato non risolve al paper churn — redirect ad auth-wall, non verificabile). Fonte reale: Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence, 'Explainable AI-driven customer churn prediction: a multi-model ensemble approach with SHAP-based feature analysis', DOI 10.3389/frai.2026.1748799 = PMC12929532 (2026). Numeri reali, attribuzione di rivista nel finding originale errata.

[VERIFIED] EXPLAINABILITY via SHAP TreeExplainer e' parte del SOTA 2026, non solo accuracy. Verificato verbatim nello stesso paper Frontiers/PMC12929532: top feature per mean |SHAP| contract_type 0.284, tenure 0.198 (rischio crolla dopo ~24 mesi). Pattern actionable verificato: payment method 'electronic check' ~45% churn vs automatic payments 18-20% -> azione = migrazione a auto-pay. CAVEAT minore: il valore monthly_charges nel finding (0.186) diverge dalla tabella del paper (0.86); ranking e pattern reggono, il singolo numero e' incerto.

[VERIFIED] UPLIFT MODELING e' il salto su upsell/retention (effetto causale incrementale del trattamento, non propensity). causalml (github.com/uber/causalml) confermato come 'A Python Package for Uplift Modeling and Causal Inference with ML' di Uber: stima CATE, 'heterogeneous treatment effect for each customer', campaign targeting optimization. arXiv 2308.09066 confermato = 'Uplift Modeling: from Causal Inference to Personalization' (Booking.com, CIKM'23). Terminologia 'sleeping dogs'/'lost causes' e' standard del campo. CAVEAT minore: il README non elenca letteralmente 'T-learner/X-learner/uplift trees' (parla di metalearners), ma gli algoritmi sono nella libreria.

[VERIFIED PARZIALMENTE — numeri vendor da depennare] AGENTIC CRM 2026 = transizione copilot -> esecuzione autonoma. VERIFICATO: Salesforce Agentforce ARR $540M (+330% YoY, ~$1.4B con Data 360), Atlas Reasoning Engine reale (System-2 inference-time reasoning). NON VERIFICATO/CORRETTO: '18.500 clienti' e' impreciso — sono 18.500 DEAL/use-case (di cui ~9.500 paganti), non clienti. HubSpot Breeze Prospecting: il '4x-7x meglio' e i '279K clienti' NON trovati in fonti (dato reale = ~2x response rate, attivazioni +57% QoQ, $1/lead outcome-based). '3B workflow/mese' non verificato. La riduzione churn '10-25%' e' marketing vendor, NON misurata in studio indipendente. Tesi di fondo (predictive protection, reattivo->proattivo) valida e direzionale.

[VERIFIED sull'ancora tecnica] DEADLINE-SENTINEL PROATTIVO 2026 = telemetria/event-driven + escalation con context-summary, NON cadenza calendario. VERIFICATO verbatim (temporal.io): durable execution con workflow stateful 'unlimited duration' (secondi->mesi), signals/timers per human-in-the-loop, 'wait up to 24 hours for approval', auto-save state. Pattern event-driven triggers + escalation a umano confermato. CAVEAT: parloa.com e mindstudio.ai sono blog vendor (peso probatorio basso, non verificati indipendentemente qui); l'architettura e' comunque corroborata dalla fonte Temporal.

opportunity: CONFIDENZA COMPLESSIVA: ALTA sul codebase (ogni claim letto in questo turn), MEDIA sul SOTA (tutti 6 i finding sono SOSTANZIALMENTE REALI — nessuno inventato — ma con 3 difetti di citazione/numero da non propagare: vedi sota_findings). Le 3 mosse restano valide perche' poggiano su tecniche verificate (gradient-boosting+SHAP, uplift causalml, durable execution), NON sui numeri vendor depennati. OPP-1 (QUICK WIN, ~2-3gg, ROI ALTISSIMO, CONFIDENZA ALTA): sbloccare deadline-sentinel visa/KITAS — codice gia' scritto e BLOCKED solo da flag DB 'visa_expiry_notifier_enabled' (verificato cron_notifiers.py:60). Basta true + cron reale + review-gate Telegram (Law 5). Per agenzia immigration il rinnovo KITAS/visa scaduto = perdita cliente + multa overstay: IL revenue-protection event. ROI: ogni rinnovo intercettato 30/60/90gg ~ 1 pratica retained vs costo zero. OPP-2 (CORE, ~2-3 settimane, ROI ALTO, CONFIDENZA ALTA su tecnica/MEDIA su data-readiness): sostituire l'euristica ltv_score con churn-model gradient-boosting (LightGBM — DA INSTALLARE, oggi ASSENTE; sklearn 1.8.0 gia' c'e' e basta per baseline GradientBoostingClassifier a costo zero, Law 2 locale) addestrato sui 11.699 clienti con label = pratica non-rinnovata/inattivita>X; + SHAP TreeExplainer per il 'perche'' per-cliente. Sostituisce 5 costanti a naso con AUC backtestabile su holdout (Law 7: prima il numero, poi il deploy). Riusa infra ClientValuePredictor (cambia solo lo scoring service). CAVEAT data-readiness: serve verificare che esista una label di churn estraibile (rinnovo pratica) prima di promettere AUC 0.93 — il 0.93 del paper e' su dataset telco pulito, non garantito sul CRM Bali Zero. OPP-3 (DIFFERENZIANTE, ~1 mese, ROI MEDIO-ALTO, CONFIDENZA MEDIA): upsell-agent con uplift modeling (causalml, DA INSTALLARE) — clienti visa-only = target cross-sell PT-PMA/tax/property; uplift evita spam ai 'sleeping dogs'. DOPO OPP-2 e dietro review umana (Law 5); l'uplift richiede dati di trattamento storici (campagne passate con outcome) che vanno verificati esistere. NOTA TRASVERSALE (CONFIDENZA ALTA): cablare PRIMA lo scheduler — run_daily_nurturing oggi gira solo nei test (verificato), quindi qualsiasi modello resta un endpoint mai chiamato, identico al fallimento auto-improvement di FASE 1.
